lines.en: label day89:
scene harukastore0
: Milk...eggs...water...
lines.zh: : 牛奶……鸡蛋……水……

lines.en: : Wait, what does she need me to {i}buy{/i} water for? Can’t she just use the tap?
lines.zh: : 等等，她让我{i}买{/i}水干什么？不能用自来水吗？

lines.en: I’m on my way home from[school] and-
lines.zh: 我正从[school]回家的路上，然后——

lines.en: Actually, let me correct that.
lines.zh: 不对，我更正一下。

lines.en: I {i}was{/i} on my way home from[school]...but then Ami decided to text me a list of things I apparently need to pick up on the way home.
lines.zh: 我{i}本来{/i}正从[school]往家走……结果 Ami 突然给我发了条短信，列了一串我显然得在回家路上买的东西。

lines.en: They’re all relatively simple ingredients, so it’s not like it’s a hassle or anything, but...
lines.zh: 都是些挺简单的食材，所以也算不上多麻烦，不过……

lines.en: Well, let's just say that I wanted to use my night for something other than just running errands.
lines.zh: 怎么说呢，我本来是打算把今晚用在跑腿之外的事情上的。

lines.en: She won't mind if I'm a little late, right?
lines.zh: 我晚一点她应该不会介意吧？

lines.en: Maybe I can hang around here for a little while before heading back?
lines.zh: 也许我可以在这一带晃一会儿再回去？

lines.en: It’s not often that I’m in this part of town, so...I doubt there's any harm in me checking out a few extra shops or something.
lines.zh: 我很少来镇上这一带，所以……顺便逛几家店应该也没什么坏处吧。

lines.en: Worse comes to worst, I can always just tell Ami I got lost.
lines.zh: 实在不行，我就跟 Ami 说迷路了。

lines.en: scene black
I cross the street and immediately find a small cafe I've never seen before.
lines.zh: 我穿过马路，立刻发现了一家从没见过的小咖啡馆。

lines.en: Without putting any thought into it, I push open the doors and wander inside- hoping to find a beautiful girl that is at least slightly open to the idea of having sex with me.
lines.zh: 我想都没想就推开门走了进去——希望能碰上一个至少不排斥跟我上床这一可能性的漂亮姑娘。

lines.en: scene harukastore1
And I wind up finding Haruka.
lines.zh: 结果我找到的是 Haruka。

lines.en: Cool.
lines.zh: 真好。

lines.en: : Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨。你怎么在这儿？

lines.en: : Haruka?
lines.zh: : Haruka？

lines.en: scene harukastore2
: Yeah, hey! Sorry, I just...wasn't expecting to see you out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 啊，嗨！抱歉，我只是……没想到会冷不丁碰见你。

lines.en: : I'm just dropping by to grab some dinner for tonight, but...
lines.zh: : 我只是顺路来买今晚的晚饭，不过……

lines.en: : I actually left my wallet at home...
lines.zh: : 我把钱包落在家里了……

lines.en: : So...now I am about to {i}postpone{/i} dinner and...go get that.
lines.zh: : 所以……现在我打算晚饭先{i}缓一缓{/i}，然后……回去拿钱包。

lines.en: : Haru-chan, you don’t need to go home, dear. You’re here every day.
lines.zh: : Haru 酱，你不用回去啦，亲爱的。你天天都来这儿。

lines.en: : Let this one be on us. The least we can do to pay you back is give you a free meal every once in a while...
lines.zh: : 这顿算我们的。我们能报答你的，也就是偶尔请你吃顿免费的饭……

lines.en: An old woman, presumably the store owner, calls out to Haruka from behind the counter.
lines.zh: 一位大概是店主的老太太从柜台后面朝 Haruka 喊道。

lines.en: scene harukastore3
: What? No! I couldn’t do something like that to you!
lines.zh: : 什么？不行！我怎么能对你们做这种事！

lines.en: : You remember I run a cafe as well, right? I know what it's like to miss out on a sale because of forgetful people like this.
lines.zh: : 你还记得我自己也开咖啡馆吧？我太清楚因为这种丢三落四的人而丢掉一笔生意是什么感觉了。

lines.en: : Just...give me like half an hour and I'll be right back. I promise.
lines.zh: : 就……给我半小时左右，我马上回来。我保证。

lines.en: : You live around here, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你住在这附近吗，Haruka？

lines.en: scene harukastore4
: Right around the corner, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实就在拐角那边。

lines.en: : I used to stop by this place every day with my-
lines.zh: : 我以前每天都和我的……一起顺路来这家店——
: 我的……

lines.en: scene harukastore5
: My {i}friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我的{i}朋友{/i}。

lines.en: : My...uhh...
: My friend and I would come here all the time and...meet up for dinner and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我和我朋友以前总来这儿，然后……聚在一起吃晚饭什么的。

lines.en: scene harukastore2
: But...enough about me! Do you live around here as well?
lines.zh: : 不过……不说我了！你也住这附近吗？

lines.en: : I’ve only seen you at the cafe and...the bistro that one time- so I have no idea if you’re local or not.
lines.zh: : 我只在咖啡馆见过你，还有……那次在小酒馆——所以我完全不知道你是不是本地人。

lines.en: : I don't really live around here, no. Just...passing by while running some errands.
lines.zh: : 我算不上住这附近，不是。只是……跑腿办事顺路经过。

lines.en: : It's no big deal, though. I'll probably just wind up taking the bus home anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过也没什么大不了的。反正我大概最后还是坐公交回家。

lines.en: scene harukastore6
: You don’t have a car?
lines.zh: : 你没有车吗？

lines.en: : Is that surprising?
lines.zh: : 这很让人意外吗？

lines.en: scene harukastore7
: What? No, I...I didn’t mean anything bad by it, I swear. I mean, it's not like you even really {i}need{/i} one in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是，我……我真没有别的意思，我发誓。我是说，在 Kumon-mi 你也确实不太{i}需要{/i}车。

lines.en: : I can always give you a ride home if you want, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是想的话，我可以捎你回家啊。

lines.en: scene harukastore2
: Only thing is we’d need to head back over to my place first since I didn't drive here.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是得先折回我家一趟，因为我不是开车来的。

lines.en: : Plus, I'd also like to come back and pick up dinner once I can actually, like...you know. Pay for it.
lines.zh: : 再说，我也想等我真的……那个，付得起钱了，再回来拿晚饭。

lines.en: : Are you sure? I wouldn’t want to burden you.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？我不想给你添麻烦。

lines.en: scene harukastore4
: Dude, it’s totally fine. I don’t mind at all. In fact, I welcome the company. I just cleaned my living room and no one's been around to be impressed by how nice it looks.
lines.zh: : 老兄，完全没问题的。我一点都不介意。说实话我还挺欢迎有人作伴的。我刚打扫完客厅，一直没人来欣赏它有多漂亮呢。

lines.en: : Do you not have people over very often?
lines.zh: : 你不常请人来家里吗？

lines.en: scene harukastore8
: No one other than the same two people who have been coming around for years now.
lines.zh: : 除了那两个常年往来的老面孔之外，就没别人了。

lines.en: : Apart from them, it's probably been...three or four years since anyone else came over?
lines.zh: : 除了她们，大概已经……三四年没有别人来过了吧？

lines.en: : Wow.
: I am incredibly lonely. Please comfort me by blessing me with your presence.
lines.zh: : 我寂寞得要命。请用你的大驾光临来抚慰我吧。

lines.en: scene harukastore9
: Platonically, of course. I promise I’m not hitting on you.
lines.zh: : 当然是纯粹精神上的啦。我保证不是在勾引你。

lines.en: scene harukastore10
: {i}Unless...{/i}
scene harukastore10r
: Wait? What? No. Don't be awkward, Haruka. Just be yourself.
lines.zh: : 等等？什么？不。别犯尴尬了，Haruka。做你自己就好。

lines.en: : I...don’t really know how to interpret this exchange, but if you’re that determined to have me over, I’ve got no problems at all.
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道该怎么理解这段对话，不过既然你这么执意要请我去，我完全没问题。

lines.en: : I can’t stay that long, though. My [niece] is expecting me with groceries.
lines.zh: : 不过我不能待太久。我的[niece]还等着我买菜回去呢。

lines.en: scene harukastore6
: Wait, you live with your [niece]? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 等等，你和你[niece]住在一起？我都不知道。

lines.en: : Of course you had no idea. We’ve only had like two real conversations since we’ve met.
lines.zh: : 你当然不知道。我们认识以来总共也没说过两次像样的话。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s {i}your{/i} fault. It’s not like you don’t have my number.
lines.zh: : 是，可那是{i}你的{/i}错啊。你又不是没有我号码。

lines.en: : And pretty soon, I’ll have your address as well.
lines.zh: : 而且很快，我连你的住址也要有了。

lines.en: scene harukastore10r2
: I’m sorry. That sounded a lot creepier than I wanted it to.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这话听起来比我想的要变态多了。

lines.en: : I don't know, man. I might be having second thoughts about this now that I know there's a chance for you to stalk me.
lines.zh: : 不好说啊，老兄。现在知道你有机会跟踪我，我可能要重新考虑一下了。

lines.en: scene harukastore10r3
: But at the same time...it's not like being stalked would be {i}that{/i} bad, would it?...
lines.zh: : 不过话又说回来……被跟踪好像也没{i}那么{/i}糟吧？……

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene harukastore2
: Well, uhh...either way, we should probably get a move on if I don't want my dinner to be ice cold by the time I pick it up.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……不管怎么说，要是我不想等回来拿的时候晚饭已经凉透了，我们大概该动身了。

lines.en: : Sure. I felt weird just standing around without ordering anything anyway.
lines.zh: : 好啊。反正我干站着什么也不点，自己也觉得怪尴尬的。

lines.en: : Great. It’s not far, I promise. We'll be there in like...fifteen minutes tops.
lines.zh: : 太好了。不远，我保证。最多……十五分钟就到了。

lines.en: scene black
Haruka and I walk through her neighborhood together, chatting about various cafe-related things to help kill time along the way.
lines.zh: 我和 Haruka 一起穿过她住的街区，聊着各种跟咖啡馆有关的事打发时间。

lines.en: For someone who is apparently extremely lonely, she’s surprisingly good at holding a conversation.
lines.zh: 一个据说寂寞得要命的人，居然意外地很会聊天。

lines.en: I don't know if I'm only thinking this due to association, but she's kind of like a...more mature version of Rin in a way.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己是不是因为联想才这么想，但从某种意义上说，她有点像……更成熟版的 Rin。

lines.en: I’m sure all the time she's spent in customer service helps with being able to talk to people, but it’s still surprising getting wrapped up in a conversation this...easy.
lines.zh: 她长年做客服培养出的人际能力肯定帮了不少忙，但能这么……轻松地聊进去，还是让人挺意外的。

lines.en: Who knows? Maybe she and I just have the type of personalities that bounce well off of one another.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？也许我和她的性格就是特别合拍。

lines.en: And maybe the natural progression of these first stages of friendship will start feeling a little {i}less{/i} natural once she starts letting her guard down.
lines.zh: 也或许，等她开始卸下防备之后，这段友谊最初阶段的自然推进就会变得{i}没那么{/i}自然了。

lines.en: scene harukastore11
: Welp, here we are!
lines.zh: : 好嘞，到啦！

lines.en: : Congratulations on being the first man here in God knows how long.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你成为天知道多少年以来第一个踏进这里的男人。

lines.en: : Thanks for having me. Also, {i}wow- what a clean living room.{/i}
lines.zh: : 谢谢招待。还有，{i}哇——客厅真干净。{/i}

lines.en: : Thanks for humoring me. I don't get those sorts of casual compliments from Sara.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你肯配合我。Sara 可从没这么随口夸过我。

lines.en: : Any time she's here, she just goes straight for the wine and it's...off to the races.
lines.zh: : 她每次来，都是直奔那瓶酒，然后……就一发不可收拾了。

lines.en: : Well, Sara is an alcoholic and I am not. Comparing the two of us doesn't really work all that well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Sara 是个酒鬼，我不是。把我俩放一块儿比其实不太合适。

lines.en: scene harukastore12
: Ehh...I don't really know if I'd say {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}这话{/i}我可不敢这么说。

lines.en: : Sara might have a drinking problem, but you guys are actually pretty similar in a bunch of ways.
lines.zh: : Sara 也许是有酗酒的问题，但你俩在很多方面其实挺像的。

lines.en: : What sort of ways are you referring to?
lines.zh: : 你说的是哪些方面？

lines.en: : That's...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : I don't know. It's kind of hard to talk about without making it sound like I'm both judging you and dishing out details about her that she probably wants to be kept secret for now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这事不太好说，怎么说都像是我既在评判你，又在把她大概还想保密的事往外抖。

lines.en: : Well, that's not ominous at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话听着一点都不吓人呢。

lines.en: scene harukastore12r
: S-Since we're on the topic of her, though...there's...
lines.zh: : 不、不过既然都聊到她了……有件……

lines.en: : Well, there's something I've been kind of wondering.
lines.zh: : 就是有件事我一直挺想问的。

lines.en: : And if this is too personal or whatever, you can just tell me to mind my own business.
lines.zh: : 如果这问题太私人什么的，你直接叫我别多管闲事就行。

lines.en: : I think I see where this is going, but shoot. What do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 我想我知道你要问什么了，不过说吧。你想知道什么？

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
scene harukastore12
: Well, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : I know you guys have been...you know...{i}intimate{/i} with each other...
lines.zh: : 我知道你们俩……那个……有过{i}亲密{/i}关系……

lines.en: : But like...are you guys officially a thing? Or just...kinda messing around?
lines.zh: : 不过……你们算是正式在一起了吗？还是……只是随便玩玩？

lines.en: scene harukastore13
: N-Not like there’s anything wrong with either of those! Like...you’re obviously both consenting adults who seem to like each other and...
lines.zh: : 我、我不是说这两种有什么不对！就是……你们显然都是两情相悦的成年人，而且……

lines.en: scene harukastore14
: And Sara is certainly very up front about her...{i}needs.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且 Sara 对自己的……{i}需求{/i}确实非常坦率。

lines.en: : I guess I'm just kind of curious. That's all.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是有点好奇。就这样。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: scene harukastore15
: I'm sorry. That was weird to ask, wasn't it?
lines.zh: : 对不起。问这个挺奇怪的吧？

lines.en: : A little, yeah. But I don't really mind.
lines.zh: : 是有那么一点。不过我真的不介意。

lines.en: : The thing is, when it comes to Sara...
lines.zh: : 问题是，说到 Sara……

lines.en: else:
: Well, uhh...I know you guys hang out sometimes, but like...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……我知道你们有时候会一起出去玩，不过……

lines.en: : I also know how Sara is.
lines.zh: : 我也知道 Sara 是什么样的人。

lines.en: : How she is? What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 什么样的人？你这话什么意思？

lines.en: scene harukastore16
: She...just...kinda really likes attention.
lines.zh: : 她……就是……挺爱被人关注的。

lines.en: : Like {i}really{/i} likes it...
lines.zh: : 是{i}真的{/i}挺爱……

lines.en: : Which isn't me talking shit or anything. She has the same needs all of us have.
lines.zh: : 我不是在说她坏话什么的。她有和我们一样的需求。

lines.en: : And since you're the first guy that's been in her life for like, years-
lines.zh: : 而且既然你是这么多年来第一个出现在她生活里的男人——

lines.en: : I get what you're saying. And I don't know if I should be saying this or not, but she already tried having sex with me once.
lines.zh: : 我明白你的意思。我不知道这话该不该说，不过她已经试过跟我上床一次了。

lines.en: scene harukastore16r
: And you...turned her down? But she's so hot.
lines.zh: : 而你……拒绝了？可她那么辣。

lines.en: : She is. But her daughter was also like, two rooms away.
lines.zh: : 是很辣。不过她女儿当时就在隔两间屋的地方。

lines.en: : That...
: Kinda makes it even hotter though...
lines.zh: : 不过这样反而更刺激了……

lines.en: : Can we pretend I didn't just say that? Because {i}I'm{/i} going to pretend I didn't just say that.
lines.zh: : 我们能当我刚才什么都没说吗？因为{i}我{/i}打算就这么假装。

lines.en: : I don't know if I should tell her what you just said or not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该把你刚才说的话告诉她。

lines.en: : Please don't. That was supposed to be an internal thought. It just...got out on accident.
lines.zh: : 别，求你了。那本来只是我心里想想的。它只是……不小心跑出来了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I can relate to that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……这种事我懂。

lines.en: : So...was it just the thing with her daughter that held you back? Or...do you have like...other reasons?
lines.zh: : 那么……拦住你的就只是她女儿那件事吗？还是……你也有……别的原因？

lines.en: : Well...
: When it comes to Sara-
lines.zh: : 说到 Sara——

lines.en: menu:
I’m interested in her
lines.zh: 我对她有兴趣

lines.en: $ sarainterest = True
: I guess I {i}am{/i} kind of interested in her. She seems like a really nice girl...just very horny.
lines.zh: : 我想我{i}确实{/i}对她有点兴趣。她看起来是个很好的女人……就是太饥渴了。

lines.en: : Not like there’s any problem with that. In fact, I-
lines.zh: : 倒不是说那有什么问题。事实上，我——

lines.en: scene harukastore17
: I’m...gonna stop you right there.
lines.zh: : 我……得在这儿打断你一下。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: I’ve already heard things from her that I can’t unhear.
lines.zh: : 我已经从她那儿听过一些我忘不掉的事了。

lines.en: : Oh? What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 哦？这话什么意思？

lines.en: : I...am going to keep my comments to myself for right now.
lines.zh: : 我……现在还是先不多评论了。

lines.en: : But if any of it is true...I am both very impressed and extremely jealous. But I would also like you to forget that I just said that.
lines.zh: : 不过如果那些事有一句是真的……我既非常佩服，又嫉妒得要死。不过我也希望你能忘掉我刚才说的话。

lines.en: : I don't know if I can.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我能不能。

lines.en: else:
: I don’t want to hear wherever this is going.
lines.zh: : 不管你要往哪儿说下去，我都不想听。

lines.en: : Really? Not even a little?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？一点也不想？

lines.en: : No way, Jose.
lines.zh: : 想都别想，老兄。

lines.en: I’m not interested in her
lines.zh: 我对她没兴趣

lines.en: $ sarainterest = False
: I don’t really see Sara that way. At least...not right now.
lines.zh: : 我没把 Sara 当成那种对象。至少……现在没有。

lines.en: : She’s definitely hot, but...I just can’t really imagine how her daughter would feel if she found out.
lines.zh: : 她确实很辣，可是……我实在想象不出她女儿要是知道了会怎么想。

lines.en: scene harukastore16
: Oh my God, you’re totally right. I didn't even think about that.
lines.zh: : 我的天，你说得太对了。我都没想到这一层。

lines.en: : That would be like, super weird for her, wouldn’t it? If my high school teacher was banging my mom, I don't even know what I would have done.
lines.zh: : 那对她来说会超级怪吧？要是我高中老师在跟我妈上床，我都不知道自己会怎么办。

lines.en: : Exactly. So I think it would probably be for the best right now if Sara and I just...stay the way we are.
lines.zh: : 没错。所以我觉得目前最好还是让 Sara 和我……保持现在这个样子。

lines.en: : That takes some serious willpower, dude. Sara’s hot as hell. She was really popular back in [high_school] too.
lines.zh: : 那可得有相当强的自制力啊，老兄。Sara 辣得要命。她在[high_school] 的时候也超受欢迎的。

lines.en: : But...I guess that’s really all I can tell you about that. The rest will have to come from her.
